MaxBattery.Notes: This profile prioritises battery life above all else; even so, 30 fps is optimistic given the game's demanding engine and the Deck's borderline hardware. If the game launches at all, expect dips below 30 fps in busy raid areas.

The most important first-run check is whether the game launches at all past the anti-cheat layer; if it does, immediately test frame rate in an open outdoor area and drop to MaxBattery settings if it cannot hold 30 fps.

MaxBattery.Notes: This profile assumes the game can be launched at all — given anti-cheat concerns, GE-Proton is the best bet. Use the lowest possible settings and FSR from a reduced render resolution to scrape playable frame rates; battery savings are secondary to simply staying in the raid.
